title: Peanut Butter Mug Cake
description: A quick single-serve microwave cake made from peanut butter, granulated sugar and eggs. Ready in under 2 minutes.
steps: Measure the peanut butter and sugar into a microwave-proof mug. Crack in the eggs and whisk everything together with a fork.
Once the batter is fully combined (it should go about three-quarters up the mug), put in the microwave and heat on high for 1–2 minutes.
Watch through the glass — the cake will rise around 2.5cm over the edge of the mug and sink slightly when done.
Use an oven glove on the handle to remove. Let the cake cool for a minute before eating.
notes: Serves 1. In a 700W microwave it takes exactly 1 minute 45 seconds. Try cashew or almond butter, or chocolate hazelnut spread.
